mediaWork.title: Murderville
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Investigates disputed murder convictions and death-row innocence claims in the American South (Season 1 Georgia; Season 2 Charles Raby in Texas).
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Investigative podcast from The Intercept hosted by reporters Liliana Segura and Jordan Smith (24 episodes). Season 2 ("Murderville, Texas") examines the case of Charles Raby, on Texas death row since 1994 after a disputed confession with no physical or DNA evidence linking him to the crime.
mediaWork.availabilityNotes: Apple Podcasts · Public RSS feed verified · ~24 episodes on Apple Podcasts
